def: Getting a program to improve at a task by fitting a function to examples instead of writing the function by hand.
One input fact about an example, such as a word count or a customer's tenure; the features form the columns of X.
The answer attached to a training example that the model is meant to predict; also called the target.
The function, learned from examples, that maps features to a prediction.
The step in which an algorithm adjusts a model's parameters to fit the training examples; also called fitting.
Learning a mapping from features to a known label, as in classification and regression.
Looking for structure in data without labels, as in clustering and dimensionality reduction.
The cycle of framing, exploring, baselining, modelling, validating, deploying and monitoring, in which modelling is one step of seven.
